upstream_behavior: xmlsave.c 2.15 xmlNodeDumpOutputInternal treats XML_DOCUMENT_FRAG_NODE as a transparent container: when the fragment's parent is intact it trampolines into cur->children and dumps them (no tags/declaration/indent of the fragment itself). Pristine PHP legacy DOMDocument::saveXML(DOMDocumentFragment) therefore returns the concatenated children bytes.
candidate_defect: node_dump_internal had no XML_DOCUMENT_FRAG_NODE arm; the match fell through to the empty arm, so dumping a fragment emitted zero bytes (and left the downstream PHP serializer returning an empty zend_string whose ownership state later double-destroyed under Zend).
php_trigger: ext/libxml/libxml.c php_libxml_default_dump_node_to_str -> xmlNodeDumpOutput(buf,doc,fragment,...) reached by ext/dom dom_document_save_xml(fragment); e.g. ext/dom/tests/DOMParentNode_empty_argument.phpt.
generic_fix: src/xml/tree/mod.rs node_dump_internal: add XML_DOCUMENT_FRAG_NODE arm that iterates children and dumps each as its own root (transparent container), matching upstream fragment descent.
